candidate_scope: all 814 physical pages of the sole official frozen R101 PDF
metadata_requirements: same PDF font name (therefore same encoded weight in this candidate)
absolute PDF effective span-size difference <= 0.25 pt
not the audited target glyph itself
deterministic_rank: on the same page: absolute rawdict sequence distance, then lower sequence
otherwise: lowest physical page, then block/line/span/char order
metric_independence: H_INK, area, mask cleanliness and pass/fail are not used to rank or replace the selected peer
post_selection_gate: selected peer must have a nonempty complete pure >=20/255 native mask; H_INK and area ratios must both be in [0.92,1.08]; otherwise FAIL with no fallback candidate
prohibited_substitution: no different codepoint, font, weight, colour, or out-of-tolerance size; no TeX
